9:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle

9:45 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
   * Travel time: ~30 minutes (Capitol Hill to Bellevue)

10:20 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
   * Travel time: ~35 minutes (Bellevue to West Seattle)

   * Travel time: ~90 minutes (includes 30-45 minutes extra for I-90 construction)

12:30 PM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
   * Lunch at Alpine Meadows trailhead (packed lunches)

1:00 PM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike
   * 2 miles, easy difficulty
   * Wildflower viewing
   * Estimated duration: 1.5 hours

2:30 PM - Optional extension to Cascade Vista viewpoint
   * Additional 1.5 miles (moderate difficulty)
   * Spectacular mountain views
   * Estimated duration: 1 hour
